name: Brandon Espana
bio: Brandon Espana (sometimes credited as Brandon España) is a Toronto born independent Filmmaker.

credits.title: Last Images Of Our Childhood Memories
credits.overview: A woman struggles to find balance in her own relationship with nostalgia while unravelling the fate of a childhood friend who vanished after becoming consumed by it.

credits.title: The Film Lost To Time
credits.overview: A film buff's obsession with an elusive, possibly nonexistent film spirals into a dangerous descent, blurring the line between reality and madness.

credits.title: Public Access Limited
credits.overview: An alien duo arrive on earth and begin to enslave humans, using a local Public Access Children's show as a front. Things get out of hand when a human is forcibly turned into one of them and joins a resistance to overthrow the aliens.

credits.title: Stir Crazy
credits.overview: To prevent himself from going insane in isolation, a young filmmaker conjures up an idea about a demented experimental director who tries to convince his harshest critic to enjoy his work.

credits.title: Forgotten Trash
credits.overview: A film graduate stumbles across an alien in the woods who convinces him to help with an intergalactic television show. In it the alien travels from planet to planet torturing and killing its inhabitants.

credits.title: Undercover Bike Cop
credits.overview: Set in a future where crime is the law, a former cop and his supernaturally possessed bike partner go undercover to preserve justice. However, when a group of leather jacket goons steal the bike he must find a way to get it back from them.

credits.title: Undercover Bike Cop: The Powder Room
credits.overview: Violet is in need of some ZATS! (A white powdered substance that enhances the senses once it is consumed). She heads to Uri who shows her what all the fuss is about the drug.

credits.title: Undercover Bike Cop: The Call
credits.overview: A mysterious informant leads a hopeful gang member closer to the identity of the "Undercover Bike Cop"

credits.title: Santa Clause: No More Fear
credits.overview: A twisted homage to Tim Allen's 'The Santa Clause'.
